verdict.rationale: Attio publishes an extensive public REST API with overview, auth (OAuth), filtering/sorting, rate limiting, and webhooks docs, giving AI-native users a documented way to programmatically read/write workspace data (attio-docs-65,7,6,32,80). Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API usability beyond first-party docs.
